---
title: "1100 — Build the ZIP-Year Panel"
subtitle: "AI-Empowered Research workshop · synthetic St. Louis data"
date: "2026-10-16"
output: html_document
---

<!--
Purpose: Collapse the cleaned student-year panel to ZIP x year (number of students,
         composition, move-in rate) and join the mock ACS ZIP panel, which supplies
         the synthetic control outcomes and predictors.
Reads:   answer_key/data_clean/1000_student_year.rds, data_raw/acs_zip_panel_mock.csv
Writes:  answer_key/data_clean/1100_zip_year.rds
Packages: here, tidyverse, knitr
-->

```{r, include = FALSE}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
set.seed(20261016)
clean_dir <- here::here("answer_key", "data_clean")
```

## Load inputs

```{r, echo = TRUE, results = 'hide', message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
panel <- read_rds(file.path(clean_dir, "1000_student_year.rds"))
acs <- read_csv(here::here("data_raw", "acs_zip_panel_mock.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  transmute(zip = as.character(zip), year,
            acs_median_income = median_income,
            acs_pct_black     = pct_black,
            acs_pop_total     = pop_total)
```

## Flag residential moves

A student **moved in** to a ZIP if they lived in a different St. Louis ZIP the year before. Students entering the panel for the first time are not counted as movers, because their prior address is unknown.

```{r, echo = TRUE, results = 'hide', message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
panel <- panel %>%
  arrange(research_id, year) %>%
  group_by(research_id) %>%
  mutate(prev_zip  = lag(zip),
         prev_year = lag(year),
         moved_in  = !is.na(prev_zip) & prev_year == year - 1 & prev_zip != zip) %>%
  ungroup()
```

## Collapse to ZIP x year

```{r, echo = TRUE, results = 'hide', message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
zip_year <- panel %>%
  group_by(zip, year) %>%
  summarise(
    n_students   = n(),
    pct_black    = mean(black),
    pct_frl      = mean(frl),
    pct_ell      = mean(ell),
    rate_move_in = mean(moved_in),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(acs, by = c("zip", "year")) %>%
  mutate(city    = zip %in% unique(panel$zip[panel$city]),
         cni_zip = zip == "63106")

stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(zip_year[c("zip", "year")]))
```

## Check the panel

The panel covers every ZIP-year. Synthetic control (`3100_synth_demo.Rmd`) uses the ACS columns, which describe each ZIP's whole population; the student columns describe the school-age sample and feed the descriptives. Donor-pool rules are applied in `3100`, so they stay visible next to the model.

```{r, echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
zip_year %>%
  summarise(zips = n_distinct(zip),
            zip_years = n(),
            years = paste(range(year), collapse = "–"),
            median_students = median(n_students),
            share_30_plus = mean(n_students >= 30),
            missing_acs = sum(is.na(acs_median_income))) %>%
  kable(digits = 2)
```

```{r, echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
zip_year %>%
  filter(cni_zip) %>%
  select(year, n_students, pct_black, pct_frl, rate_move_in, acs_pop_total, acs_pct_black, acs_median_income) %>%
  kable(digits = 3, caption = "ZIP 63106 by year")
```

## Save

```{r, echo = TRUE, results = 'hide', message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
write_rds(zip_year, file.path(clean_dir, "1100_zip_year.rds"))
```
